officialTitle: Nivolumab alone and nivolumab plus ipilimumab in recurrent small-cell lung cancer (CheckMate 032): a multicentre, open-label, phase 1/2 trial

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: Between Nov 18, 2013, and July 28, 2015, 216 patients were enrolled and treated (98 with nivolumab 3 mg/kg, three with nivolumab 1 mg/kg plus ipilimumab 1 mg/kg, 61 with nivolumab 1 mg/kg plus ipilimumab 3 mg/kg, and 54 with nivolumab 3 mg/kg plus ipilimumab 1 mg/kg).
design.notes: Initial non-randomised cohorts (interim analysis, 2016). A later randomised expansion cohort (3:2 nivolumab vs nivolumab plus ipilimumab; ORR by BICR) was reported in 2019 and is recorded as a separate publication. Evidence is phase 1/2 and largely non-comparative.

clinicalQuestion: What is the activity and safety of nivolumab with or without ipilimumab in SCLC progressing after platinum-based chemotherapy?

pico.population: Limited- or extensive-stage SCLC progressing after at least one platinum-containing regimen
pico.intervention: Nivolumab monotherapy or nivolumab plus ipilimumab
pico.comparator: None in initial cohorts; nivolumab monotherapy in the randomised expansion cohort

arms.label: Nivolumab 3 mg/kg
arms.doseSourceQuote: Patients received nivolumab (3 mg/kg bodyweight intravenously) every 2 weeks (given until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity)

arms.label: Nivolumab 1 mg/kg + ipilimumab 3 mg/kg
arms.dosing: Nivolumab 1 mg/kg plus ipilimumab 3 mg/kg every 3 weeks for four cycles, then nivolumab 3 mg/kg every 2 weeks
arms.doseSourceQuote: or nivolumab plus ipilimumab (1 mg/kg plus 1 mg/kg, 1 mg/kg plus 3 mg/kg, or 3 mg/kg plus 1 mg/kg, intravenously) every 3 weeks for four cycles, followed by nivolumab 3 mg/kg every 2 weeks.

arms.label: Nivolumab 3 mg/kg + ipilimumab 1 mg/kg
arms.dosing: Nivolumab 3 mg/kg plus ipilimumab 1 mg/kg every 3 weeks for four cycles, then nivolumab 3 mg/kg every 2 weeks
arms.doseSourceQuote: or nivolumab plus ipilimumab (1 mg/kg plus 1 mg/kg, 1 mg/kg plus 3 mg/kg, or 3 mg/kg plus 1 mg/kg, intravenously) every 3 weeks for four cycles, followed by nivolumab 3 mg/kg every 2 weeks.

publications.title: Nivolumab alone and nivolumab plus ipilimumab in recurrent small-cell lung cancer (CheckMate 032): a multicentre, open-label, phase 1/2 trial.
publications.label: Interim analysis, non-randomised cohorts

publications.title: Nivolumab Monotherapy and Nivolumab Plus Ipilimumab in Recurrent Small Cell Lung Cancer: Results From the CheckMate 032 Randomized Cohort.
publications.label: Randomised cohort results

outcomes.sourceQuote: An objective response was achieved in ten (10%) of 98 patients receiving nivolumab 3 mg/kg, one (33%) of three patients receiving nivolumab 1 mg/kg plus ipilimumab 1 mg/kg, 14 (23%) of 61 receiving nivolumab 1 mg/kg plus ipilimumab 3 mg/kg, and ten (19%) of 54 receiving nivolumab 3 mg/kg plus ipilimumab 1 mg/kg.

outcomes.population: Treated patients, nivolumab 1 mg/kg plus ipilimumab 3 mg/kg cohort
outcomes.sourceQuote: An objective response was achieved in ten (10%) of 98 patients receiving nivolumab 3 mg/kg, one (33%) of three patients receiving nivolumab 1 mg/kg plus ipilimumab 1 mg/kg, 14 (23%) of 61 receiving nivolumab 1 mg/kg plus ipilimumab 3 mg/kg, and ten (19%) of 54 receiving nivolumab 3 mg/kg plus ipilimumab 1 mg/kg.

outcomes.endpointLabel: ORR by blinded independent central review
outcomes.population: Randomised cohort (nivolumab n=147; nivolumab + ipilimumab n=96)
outcomes.sourceQuote: ORR increased with nivolumab plus ipilimumab (21.9% versus 11.6% with nivolumab; odds ratio: 2.12; 95% confidence interval: 1.06-4.26; p = 0.03).
median (95% confidence interval) OS was 5.7 (3.8-7.6) versus 4.7 months (3.1-8.3). Twenty-four-month OS rates were 17.9% (nivolumab) and 16.9% (nivolumab plus ipilimumab).
Twenty-four-month OS rates were 17.9% (nivolumab) and 16.9% (nivolumab plus ipilimumab).

safety.description: Grade 3-4 treatment-related adverse events, randomised cohort
safety.sourceQuote: Grade 3 to 4 treatment-related adverse event rates were 12.9% (nivolumab) versus 37.5% (nivolumab plus ipilimumab), and treatment-related deaths were n =1 versus n = 3, respectively.
treatment-related deaths were n =1 versus n = 3, respectively.

strengths: Large multicohort experience with long-term OS follow-up
Randomised expansion cohort with central response review
limitations: Phase 1/2 design; initial cohorts non-randomised and descriptive
Higher response with the combination did not translate into longer OS in the randomised cohort
Substantially more toxicity with combination therapy

clinicalImplications.text: Showed durable responses in a minority of patients with relapsed SCLC treated with nivolumab with or without ipilimumab; the combination increased response and toxicity without an OS advantage.

tumourBoardPearl.text: In relapsed SCLC, adding ipilimumab to nivolumab raised response rates but not survival, and increased toxicity.

curation.notes: Numbers transcribed from PubMed abstracts of PMID 27269741 (interim, non-randomised cohorts) and PMID 31629915 (randomised cohort). The nivolumab 1 mg/kg plus ipilimumab 1 mg/kg cohort (n=3) is not recorded as a separate arm.
